payload.text: A WARNING CAN NAME THE WRONG OWNER, and its wording is what makes a reader edit a file that is already correct. Measured at Laksa by laksa-dc, 2026-09-22: the deprecation reading xref: exclude in your mix.exs file is emitted from DEPS own mix.exs files (assent, phoenix_ecto, postgrex, rewrite), while Laksa's mix.exs has no xref key at HEAD or at the run commit. They nearly filed it as a Laksa fix, and every Elixir estate in the fleet will meet it. Before acting on a warning that says YOUR file, check that the file it names is yours.
